title: Gate F: the scientific tools connected to the governed research loop
note: D-2026-180. GF1-GF3 derive a contract that hides an assumption, a limitation or the check; GF4-GF7 show a tampered contract, one naming another check, run a model no contract offers, or show none; GF8-GF11 report a scientific context that is not the bundle's, omits what the check cannot show, forgets who verified it, or keeps a withdrawn result standing. tests/test_research_science.py holds each.

mutations.name: GF3_a_contract_without_the_check_s_limits
